spec.name: Rose Festival of Kelaat M'Gouna
spec.description: Harvest festival of the Damask rose in the Valley of Roses around Kelaat M'Gouna, held since the 1960s. The town celebrates the rose harvest with parades, ahwach performances, a rose-products souk and the crowning of the Rose Queen.

recurrence.note: Dates track the rose harvest and are confirmed a few weeks ahead
